title: SSS at SemEval-2023 Task 10: Explainable Detection of Online Sexism using Majority Voted Fine-Tuned Transformers
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical application of transformer-based models (like DeBERTa and RoBERTa) to the task of detecting and classifying online sexism. While it addresses social bias (sexism), it does not benchmark or evaluate religious traditions, theological concepts, or formal systems of morals and ethics.
